purpose: Define how a future reward ablation winner may be selected, without selecting any winner in this step.

selection_tiers.name: eligibility_filter
selection_tiers.description: Only actual, complete, hard-constraint-passing results can be eligible.

selection_tiers.name: service_quality_rank
selection_tiers.description: Prioritize passenger service rate, wait, p95 wait, bunching, headway CV, and on-time rate.

selection_tiers.name: efficiency_secondary_rank
selection_tiers.description: Use energy per passenger and fleet reduction only as secondary tie-breakers.

selection_tiers.name: stability_and_seed_robustness
selection_tiers.description: Prefer lower seed variance and no condition-specific collapse.

disqualifying_conditions: Any paper_level_claim_allowed=true before later evidence gate
Any causal_performance_claim_allowed=true before later evidence gate
Any reward candidate that improves energy by reducing passenger_service_rate below floor
Any winner chosen from no-op, template, mock, smoke-only, or dry-run outputs
